verdict.rationale: Missive's MCP integration explicitly enables an AI agent to "triage new conversations against your CRM before you look at them" and to "summarize your inbox and draft replies," with permission scopes the user chooses (docs-20/21/22, probe-rt-2 confirming live OAuth-scoped read/write/draft/calendar access) and an auditable session tab plus full action logging (docs-2/9/34) for steering/auditing. However this triage is delivered via external AI apps/custom MCP rather than a native built-in auto-labeling/categorization engine, and there's no evidence of hands-on validation of triage quality or of automatic label/category assignment inside Missive itself — missing for 10: native automatic labeling/categorization feature (vs. rule-based automation), independent hands-on evidence of triage accuracy, and clearer UI for reviewing/undoing AI-assigned categories.
